comment: Great professor, best Spanish professor I ever had.  Gorgeous butt, too.

Great teacher!  She may seem a bit intimidating at first but once you get to know her she is wonderful and extremely helpful.  She really wants her students to do well which is why she does somewhat have high expectations.
Professor Lopez Opere is very helpful, however the class does move quickly. Previous knowledge of spanish is extremely helpful!

Intense everyday course, as advertised. This was her first semester, so she will improve-not to say that she isn't a great teacher, but she's hard and occasionally cold. Check syllabus daily. Expect to work for this class, but you can't beat a Spanish teacher from Madrid. She cares about her students and wants to help. She's easy on the eyes, too.
